mapper.sql: task_id, user_id, file_key, status, raw_data, confirmed_data, image_urls, anomaly_summary, ai_raw_output, processed_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT task_id FROM tasks ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (task_id, user_id, file_key, status, raw_data, confirmed_data, image_urls, anomaly_summary, ai_raw_output, processed_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{fileKey}, #{status}, #{rawData}, #{confirmedData}, #{imageUrls}, #{anomalySummary}, #{aiRawOutput}, #{processedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status = #{status}, raw_data = #{rawData}, confirmed_data = #{confirmedData}, image_urls = #{imageUrls}, anomaly_summary = #{anomalySummary}, ai_raw_output = #{aiRawOutput}, processed_by = #{processedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE tasks SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
